name: dynamic-grid
description: A responsive animated grid background driven by CSS variables for SaaS, code, and data scenes

vars.description: Cell size of the grid: fine reads as graph paper, coarse as a few large panels.
Thickness of the grid lines, from a hairline rule to a bold structural grid.
Line colour: neutral is the translucent white the original ships with, and the accents ride --brand, --accent and --accent-2.
